title: Continuous Phase Foliations Create Analytic Caustic Collars
summary: For a smooth strictly convex planar billiard of positive curvature, a continuous foliation of a full grazing annulus by individually invariant essential curves forces an analytic boundary and a jointly analytic collar of smooth strictly convex caustics. The physical-collar rigidity theorem proved in the companion article then implies that the table is an ellipse.

review.reason: Proves analyticity of billiard boundaries from continuous foliations, concluding the table is an ellipse.
